name: Cuergo's Gold
label: Quest
description: Cuergo's Gold: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This map shows a stretch of beach with a southern face. Below the map are words, elegantly written...
Find a mast and flag and bones
Dig you there, if you be bold
A key you'll need and a key you'll see
The men you face take blood as fee.
